api.targets: Exact empty array; identity UUIDs remain stable, this domain renames only the local fragment key and raw related references
api.localIdentity: Case-sensitive ASCII [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,63}; no trim or normalization; old identity must exist and new identity must not belong to another fragment
api.nativeNoop: Same decoded identity returns exact original bytes and [] after complete original validation
api.unsupportedRename: studio_core_unavailable without disabling any existing domain
api.bridgeReceipt: Complete semantic intent, exact source-ordered changedPaths and string token inventory: only identity value tokens may change; all token gaps and unrelated raw strings remain byte-identical

portableSource.digest: Explicit injected bare hex64 digest port
portableSource.prepared: Parent separately verifies actual prepared desktop/mobile VM copies; source proof is not device acceptance

retainedAttempts.result: Initial compile failed because the new module passed tuple edits to the existing Edit struct API. New module corrected to reuse the exact shared Edit type; no existing helper changed.

retainedAttempts.reason: The initial lexical preservation test expected a global textual replacement, incorrectly changing same-named group keys and memberships. Actual core preserved those fields; new test now builds the expected result using only identity value source ranges. No product change was required.
Initial bridge suite already passed; final log repeats the frozen source.

boundaries: Single-file stateless atomic identity rename; no filesystem/tool process/resource lease or metadata mutation

CST edits replace only the fragment declaration identity value and all related placement fragmentId value tokens; escaped property keys, BOM/CRLF, numeric spelling, object references, local actor/group keys, UUIDs, order, offset and overrides retained
Unused fragments can be renamed; no new instance or UUID is allocated and full expanded scene semantics remain stable
Original and final full composition expansion with existing 128KiB and declaration/instance budgets; atomic growth rejected and shorter identifiers can reduce source size
Strict complete model/organizational semantics/provenance binds original source; snapshots precede asynchronous digest and host recomputes the entire intent/receipt
Old three author actions and read-only source locator remain separate; missing/wrong rename ABI only disables rename
Lightweight string token inventory only verifies response byte preservation; Rust remains the mutation and CST source-location authority
Root owns GUI/candidate/workflow/full application/browser/prepared/cleanup verification; this report records core, pure and source-portable checks only
